question_en: List Samsung's TDocs, newest first (contributor tracking).
original_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName:'Samsung'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber ORDER BY t.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10
reference_query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName:'Samsung'})
MATCH (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem)
RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt, a.agendaNumber AS agendaNumber
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, agendaNumber ASC, tdocNumber ASC
